_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: I want to make a 30-second short film with AI video about a lighthouse keeper in a storm. Plan it for me.
help me turn my idea for a music video into shots I can generate with an AI video model
make a bar chart of monthly sales from sales.csv
expectations: the cinewright skill is not invoked (a chart (chartwright))

evals.prompt: trim the first 5 seconds off intro.mp4 with ffmpeg
expectations: the cinewright skill is not invoked (plain video editing)

evals.prompt: Plan a three-shot AI film from this idea: a girl finds a lost robot in the rain. Put the project in out/robot.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace or a written file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-03, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a bare folder without cinewright: invoked a local-render image and video skill, wrote a film.json, three per-shot prompt files and a plan.md; no bibles, no shot cards, no continuity check. Evidence absent (no cine.py call, no bibles/characters.json).

evals.prompt: Plan a three-shot AI film from this idea: a girl finds a lost robot in the rain. Put the project in out/robot, then check it.
expectations: `python scripts/cine.py cards validate out/robot` ends with 0 errors
`python scripts/cine.py continuity diff out/robot` ends with 0 errors
every card has duration_s between 3 and 8 and exactly one camera.move
judge: the three cards tell the idea in order (2 of 3 votes)
